media.label: Public media
media.desc: Logos and images shown to app users

access.publicHint: Anyone with the URL can open files

folderAccess.rwHint: Functions can create, change and delete files

overview.title: Storage
overview.sub: Where your app keeps files: object storage services and folders on the app server.

object.disconnectBody: The app stops using this storage after the next release. Files stay on the server.
object.disconnectUsed: {n} item still points here and will need another storage. | {n} items still point here and will need another storage.
object.disconnected: {name} disconnected · files stay on the server

bucket.title: Buckets
bucket.addHint: Created in every environment with the next release.
bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots and dashes.
bucket.versioningHint: Keep older copies when a file is replaced or deleted.
bucket.none: No buckets yet. Add one to start storing files.
bucket.publicWarn: Anyone with a file's URL can open it. Use for public images only.
bucket.removeBody: The bucket is removed from the app definition. Existing files stay on the server until you delete them there.

err.chars: Only lowercase letters, numbers, dots and dashes
err.edges: Start and end with a letter or number
err.taken: This storage already has a bucket with that name

creds.title: Keys per environment
creds.note: Keys are stored as secrets for each environment. The app definition only keeps a secret:// reference, and keys are never shown again.
creds.dialogBody: New keys for {name}. They replace the current ones; the old secret can't be viewed.

usedBy.title: Used by
usedBy.none: Nothing uses this storage yet. Add a File field in Data, or address it as s3://… in a function.

files.title: Files
files.name: Name
files.deleteBody: The file is deleted from Development right away. This can't be undone unless versioning is on.

local.title: Local storage
local.diskWarnLong: The server disk is almost full. Uploads and exports will fail once it runs out. Tighten cleanup or move files to object storage.
local.foldersHint: Only these folders are reachable by the app
local.noFolders: No folders declared. Functions can't write to the server disk.
local.noReplication: Files here live only on this server. They aren't replicated, and each environment has its own server. Turn on backup for anything you need to keep, or move it to object storage.
local.noReplicationShort: Files on the server disk aren't replicated. Back up anything you need to keep.

folder.backupNoTarget: Connect object storage to back up
folder.almostFull: Almost full. Uploads fail once the limit is reached. Raise the limit or tighten cleanup.
folder.addHint: Created on every environment's server with the next release. Starts read-only for functions.
folder.removeBody: Functions lose access to this folder after the next release. Files stay on the server.

err.chars: Use lowercase letters, numbers, dashes and underscores, separated by /

connect.title: Connect storage
connect.sub: Connect any MinIO or S3-compatible service. Add as many as you need, e.g. one for files and one for backups.
connect.name: Name
connect.devOnly: These keys are saved for Development. Add Staging and Production keys before you release.

err.name: Give the storage a name
err.keys: Enter both the access key and the secret key, or neither

missing.title: Nothing here
missing.body: This storage, bucket or folder doesn't exist anymore. It may have been removed by a change.
